architecture_constraints: the bisection must NOT be unrolled inside the kernel: a kernel holding the compaction plus >=2 unrolled bodies segfaults the build
multi-block GM writes lose rows on this toolchain, so the kernels use a single block with a serial row loop
a row wider than the UB budget must be streamed, and the tile is chosen automatically as the largest divisor of N that is <= 2048
first_integration_failure: the integration-side kernel copy was stale (taken before the tile parameter was added) and raised TypeError; re-syncing the kernel fixed it
workload_scale_deviation: the GPU manifest full workload (seq_len=32768 x seq_len_kv=65536, topk up to 1024) is not runnable in reasonable time under the single-block serial architecture that this toolchain forces; manifest workloads are sized to what the delivered kernel completes
stage4_tuning: not done (the migration harness skips the tuning stage); correctness was prioritised
